scope: Independent verification-skill maintenance only; product sources unchanged from base.

before.observation: Native available memory exceeded the threshold, but the original guard used unused pages and refused before any services started.

after.observation: Real isolated Agent Server, automation, frontend and ingress started with default threshold; doctor passed auth/health/build identity/browser checks.

regressionChecks.red: Four Darwin cases failed before the one-line production change; Linux and fallback cases already passed.
regressionChecks.green: 100/100 tests across the two verification JS suites.

limits: Memory snapshots are adjacent measurements, not simultaneous or a guarantee of future capacity.
Native available memory is an estimate including reclaimable pages; memory-pressure percentages were not converted to bytes.
Older native runtimes may retain a conservative unused-memory reading.
The failing preflight has no running-Canvas screenshot because it does not start the app.
The after screenshot proves startup, not an LLM response or onboarding success.
The run is subsequently used for a separate status-class baseline capture and will be stopped afterward.
